items.title: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-World Generation at Scale
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05248v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generating large-scale, freely explorable 3D worlds from open-ended text remains challenging because a system must jointly maintain global spatial coherence, rich local content, and explicit assets suitable for downstream editing and reuse. We present WorldClaw, a fully agentic, coarse-to-fine framework for open-world 3D scene generation. Planning agents translate a text prompt into a structured specification of regions, terrain, assets, materials, and spatial relations. WorldClaw then builds a globally coherent terrain foundation from semantic layouts, reusable assets, generative or procedural materials, and a region-aware height field. For detail-demanding regions, it generates terrain-conditioned compositions, reconstructs editable textured meshes, and recovers their placement on the terrain; render-based agents further refine terrain, objects, appearance, and contacts. items.title: Woodpecker Distillation: Weak Models Diagnose Reasoning Bugs in Strong Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05168v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models often fail on reasoning tasks despite possessing the capability to solve them. We argue that many such failures arise from localized reasoning bugs in intermediate steps rather than from global incompetence. We show that these bugs are frequently repairable: inserting a short patch generated by a weak probe model after the same strong-model reasoning prefix can redirect the trajectory toward a correct solution.
  However, this corrective effect is not reliably internalized by directly fine-tuning on weak patches or repaired trajectories, suggesting that the useful signal lies not in the intervention text itself, but in how it reshapes the model's future reasoning distribution. We therefore propose Woodpecker Distillation, a weak-to-strong training framework that learns from contrastive local interventions. items.summary_zh: 本文提出啄木鸟蒸馏（Woodpecker Distillation）方法，利用弱模型诊断强模型中的推理错误。大型语言模型在推理任务中常失败，尽管具备解决能力。作者认为许多失败源于中间步骤的局部推理错误，而非整体能力不足。这些错误通常可修复：在相同位置插入由弱探针模型生成的短补丁，可显著提升性能。论文可能通过实验证明该方法在多种推理任务上的有效性，并分析其机制。

items.title: Search2Skill: Skill Distillation Beyond Knowledge Boundaries Via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05245v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reusable skills, which encapsulate the procedural knowledge required to solve real-world professional tasks, offer LLM-based agents a path toward self-evolution in expert domains. Existing self-evolving skill methods construct skills internally from the model's parametric knowledge or trajectories, and are therefore bounded by what the model already knows. However, the domain conventions and standard procedures underlying professional skills often lie beyond this boundary and are hard to elicit from the agent alone. To address this issue, we therefore propose a novel framework, Search2Skill, that automatically identifies the agent's capability gaps, searches external sources to address them, and distills the retrieved evidence into structured, reusable skills. items.summary_zh: 本文提出Search2Skill框架，通过基于规则的强化学习从外部搜索中蒸馏可复用技能，突破模型参数知识的限制。现有方法仅从内部知识构建技能，受限于模型已知内容。Search2Skill利用外部搜索获取新知识，并通过强化学习优化技能提取，使智能体在专业领域实现自我进化。实验证明该方法能有效提升任务解决能力。

items.title: The pattern that made my AI outputs actually usable: research → interview → quality gate, in that order
items.raw_text:
Most prompts fail for the same reason: they ask the model to write before it knows what's working and who it's writing for.

I spent a few months iterating on a structure that fixed this for me. The pattern:

Step 1 — Research first, write second
Before any output, the prompt fetches what's currently performing in that format. LinkedIn hooks from this week, cold email structures with current reply rates, pitch deck narratives that are closing right now. Not cached knowledge. Live context pulled before the writing starts.

Step 2 — Three calibrating questions
Not open-ended. Specific: what's your target's role level, what stage is the company, what's your one ask. items.summary_zh: 作者发现大多数提示失败是因为让模型在了解有效内容和目标受众之前就写作。他花了几个月迭代出一个结构：第一步先研究，获取当前有效的格式；第二步进行访谈，明确受众需求；第三步设置质量门控，确保输出符合标准。这个模式显著提高了AI输出的可用性，值得借鉴。
